DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前のご相談についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about your previous consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、近所で大きな音がしたと話しましたが、時刻を間違えていたかもしれません。訂正を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前申告した近所の音の時刻を訂正したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday I said I heard a loud noise in the neighborhood, but I may have got the time wrong. I would like to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to correct the time you previously reported for the noise in the neighborhood. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのように気づかれましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その時に友達へ送ったメッセージを見ました。九時と言いましたが、送ったのは八時半でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 九時申告に対し送信記録は八時半と気づいた理由を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I checked the message I sent a friend at the time. I said nine o'clock, but I sent it at eight thirty.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you noticed the sending record showed eight thirty although you reported nine. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メッセージの時刻と、音を聞いた時刻は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Was the time of the message the same as the time you heard the noise?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 音の後で送りました。すぐだったと思いますが、何分後かは分かりません。八時半ぴったりとも言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 音の後の送信で正確な時間差は不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I sent it after the noise. I think it was soon afterward, but I do not know how many minutes later. I cannot say it was exactly eight thirty either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the message was sent after the noise and the exact interval is unknown. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できたことを、そのまま記録に追加しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us add exactly what you were able to confirm to the record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。前に九時と話したことと、今分かった送信時刻の両方を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 過去申告と新しく確認した送信時刻を両方伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will tell you both that I previously said nine o'clock and the sending time I have now found.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give both your previous report and the newly confirmed sending time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 音の場所や種類についても、新しく確認したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you also confirmed anything new about the location or type of noise?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そこは増えていません。ほかの人の話を自分が聞いた音として付け足さず、時刻の点だけ訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所種類は新情報なしで時刻のみの訂正と範囲を定める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have no new information about those. I want to correct only the time, without adding what other people said as though it were a noise I heard myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Clarify that there is no new information about the location or type and that the correction concerns only the time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。それでは、以前の相談を確認します。訂正のお申し出ありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then I will check your previous consultation. Thank you for telling us about the correction. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの発送をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about mailing a card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。海外の友達へ、私が練習した日本語の字を送ります。カードの中の字が下手でも、送る手続きには困りませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 海外友人への自筆日本語カードと字の巧拙の影響を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am sending a friend overseas the Japanese handwriting I have been practicing. Will poor handwriting inside the card cause any problems with mailing it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending a handwritten Japanese card to a friend overseas and whether the quality of the handwriting matters. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードの内容の字と、宛先の記入は別に確認します。送る国はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the writing inside the card separately from the address. Have you decided which country to send it to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この国です。カードは日本語ですが、宛先は友達が送ってくれた表記を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送付国を示し住所は受取人指定表記を使いたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: This country. The card is in Japanese, but I would like to use the address exactly as my friend sent it to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Indicate the destination country and say that you want to use the address format specified by the recipient. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛先の書き方や、この国への取扱いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain how to write the address and whether service is available to this country.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。中の文章を翻訳し直すより先に、外側の宛先を読めるように書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本文翻訳より外側の宛先を読みやすく書く希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before translating the text inside again, I would like to write the address clearly on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to write the outside address legibly before translating the main text. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容品や封筒についても確認します。カード以外の物は入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also check the contents and envelope. Will you put anything besides the card inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙のカード一枚だけです。練習した鉛筆は入れず、字だけを見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙カード一枚で鉛筆等は同封しないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just one paper card. I will not enclose the pencil I practiced with; I only want my friend to see the writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that there is only one paper card and that you will not enclose a pencil or other items. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容で、利用できる方法と料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the available methods and prices for those contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友達の住所を写したら、数字を一つずつ見直します。料金を聞いてから送り方を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所数字を照合し料金確認後に発送方法を選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After copying my friend's address, I will check the numbers one by one. I will choose a mailing method after hearing the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the address numbers and choose a mailing method after confirming the price. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、宛先の記入方法をご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then I will explain how to write the address. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その用紙は、今日のお手続きにお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using those forms for a procedure today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。裏が白いので、子どものお絵かき用にもらおうと思って、何枚か取りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手続きでなく子供絵用に白い裏の用紙を取ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. The backs are blank, so I took a few sheets thinking I could have them for my child to draw on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you took forms with blank backs for your child to draw on, rather than for a procedure. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは手続きに使う用紙です。お絵かき用としてはお持ちにならないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: These forms are for procedures. Please do not take them for drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。使った人の紙ではなく、まだ書いていない物でしたが、自由な紙という意味ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未記入でも自由用途ではないと理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. They were unused sheets, not papers someone had already used, but that does not mean they are available for any purpose, does it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your understanding that even blank forms are not for unrestricted use. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な手続きの分をお取りください。今、何か書き込んだ物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please take only what you need for your procedure. Have you written on any of them now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚に絵を描いてしまいました。戻してほかの人に使ってもらうのではなく、この一枚の扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一枚に描いたと申告し未使用棚へ戻さず扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have already drawn on one. Rather than putting it back for someone else to use, I would like to ask what to do with this sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you drew on one sheet and ask how to handle it without returning it to the unused shelf. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き込んだ用紙はこちらで確認します。残りの未使用分は元の場所へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the sheet you wrote on here. Please return the remaining unused ones to their original place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。未使用の物を戻します。子どもには、家で用意した紙を使うと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未使用分を戻し子供へ家庭用紙を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will return the unused ones. I will tell my child to use paper we provide at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will return the unused sheets and tell your child to use paper from home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。お手続きのご案内は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Do you need information about any procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は必要ありません。絵を描いた一枚をお渡しして、未使用の紙を戻してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手続き不要で記入済一枚を職員へ渡し未使用を戻すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Not today. I will give you the sheet I drew on and return the unused paper before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you do not need any procedure, will hand the marked sheet to a staff member, and will return the unused sheets. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、その一枚を確認します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then I will check that sheet. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の量について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the quantity of the products?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 冷凍の商品をいくつか選びましたが、持ってきた保冷バッグには全部入りそうにありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍品を選び過ぎ持参保冷袋へ収まらないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I chose several frozen products, but I do not think they will all fit in the insulated bag I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you chose too many frozen products to fit in your insulated bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お帰りまで、どのくらいかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: How long will it take you to get home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一時間ほどです。この後にも買い物の予定がありましたが、冷たい物を買ったら先に家へ帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帰宅一時間で購入後は寄道をやめ先に帰る計画を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: About an hour. I planned to do more shopping afterward, but after buying chilled items I want to go home first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the journey home takes an hour and that after buying these items you plan to skip further stops and go home first. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち帰り方を考えてから商品をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please think about how you will take the products home before choosing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。バッグへ無理に詰める前に、今日は必要な分だけにします。まだ商品の袋は開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封で必要量へ減らすと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Before cramming them into the bag, I will reduce them to what I need today. I have not opened any of the product bags yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the products are unopened and that you will reduce them to the amount you need. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻す商品の状態を、売り場で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the condition of the products you are returning at the sales area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。小さい包装なら入るかもしれませんが、数が増えたら同じなので、量も見て選び直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小包装でも個数で容量超過になるため量も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Smaller packages might fit, but if I take more of them I will have the same problem, so I will check the quantity as well and choose again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that even small packages can exceed capacity if there are too many, so you will also check the quantity. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 袋の大きさと内容量を合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check both the size of the bags and the quantity inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。収まる量を確認してから会計し、寄り道せず持ち帰ります。余分に取った物は案内された所へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 収まる量のみ会計し余剰品は指定売場へ戻すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will check how much fits before paying and take it home without stopping elsewhere. I will return the extra items to the place you direct me to.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will pay only for what fits and return extra products to the designated sales area. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、売り場で確認しましょう。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then let us check at the sales area. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 昔の公園の写真をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have an old photograph of the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。父のアルバムにありました。今ここで撮った写真と並べたいですが、同じ遊具なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父の旧アルバムと現写真を並べるが遊具同一性不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It was in my father's album. I want to put it beside a photo I took here now, but I do not know whether it is the same playground equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to compare a photo from your father's old album with a current photo but do not know whether the equipment is the same. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真に写っている場所を、現在の案内図で確かめられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you check the location shown in the photo on the current guide map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池の形が似ています。ただ、昔の写真の滑り台は今見当たらないので、名前だけ同じに書いてよいか迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池形は似るが旧滑台が見当たらず名称表記を迷うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: The shape of the pond looks similar. But I cannot find the slide in the old photo now, so I was unsure whether I could just write the same name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the pond looks similar but the old slide is missing, leaving you unsure which name to write. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真だけで設備の変更時期や名前を確定するのは難しいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is difficult to establish equipment names or when they changed from photographs alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですね。父が「ここで遊んだ」と言ったことと、同じ遊具が残っていることは別に書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 父の遊んだ記憶と現存設備の同一性を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: That's true. I would like to write separately that my father said he played here and whether the same equipment is still here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish your father's memory of playing there from whether the same equipment still exists. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 過去の公園の資料を確認できるか、担当へお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can ask the responsible department whether old park records are available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。古い写真の撮影年もまだ分からないので、父に聞くことと資料で確認することを分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 撮影年を父に聞くことと旧資料で調べることを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me with that. I do not yet know the year the old photo was taken either, so I will separate what I ask my father from what I check in the records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate asking your father about the year of the photograph from checking old records. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かった範囲を整理して、ご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please organize what you have found out before asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今の写真へ古い名前を決めて付けず、まず父に時期を聞きます。昔と今の違いを楽しみながら調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未確定旧名を現写真へ付さず時期を聞いて調べると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not assign an unconfirmed old name to the current photo; first I will ask my father when it was. I want to enjoy investigating the differences between then and now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not label the current photo with an unconfirmed old name, and will ask about the date and investigate. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、資料について担当へご案内します。思い出の写真を大切になさってください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will direct you to the department responsible for records. Please treasure those photographs and memories. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅の周辺の道を確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking the streets around the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明るい時間に坂道を歩いて来ましたが、帰るのは夜です。同じ道を戻るか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼の坂道を夜に戻るか迷い駅周辺経路を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I walked here up a slope while it was light, but I will return at night. I am unsure whether to go back the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about routes around the station because you are unsure whether to return at night along the slope you used during the day. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先と、歩いて来た道を案内図で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you point out your destination and the route you walked on the guide map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この辺りです。近道を通りましたが、途中に階段があり、街灯があるかは見ていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図で近道階段と街灯未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around here. I took a shortcut, but it had stairs along the way, and I did not check whether there were streetlights.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the shortcut and stairs on the map, and say that you have not checked the streetlights. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 周辺の案内でほかの経路も確認できます。歩く以外の方法も検討されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check other routes in the local information too. Would you also consider ways of traveling besides walking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。距離だけ短ければよいと思っていましたが、夜は足元が分かる方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 短距離だけでなく夜の足元と代替移動を考えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I thought a short distance was all that mattered, but at night I want to choose a way that lets me see where I am stepping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to consider visibility underfoot at night and alternative transport, as well as distance. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 交通手段についても、その時間の案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the transport information for that time of day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。今走っている乗り物が夜もあると決めず、帰る時間に合うか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の交通と夜の運行を区別して予定時刻を確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please help me. Rather than assuming transport running now will also run at night, I would like to ask whether it fits my return time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish current transport from nighttime service and say that you want to confirm your planned time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 帰る予定の時刻を含めて、案内をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the information including the time you plan to return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。帰りの列車の時刻も合わせてメモし、近道を使うかどうかは経路と時間を確認してから決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 帰り列車も含め経路時間を確認後に方法を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I will also note my return train time and decide whether to take the shortcut after checking the route and times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide how to travel after checking routes and times, including your return train. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、周辺の案内をご覧ください。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please look at the local information. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アンケートの記入についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about filling in the questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。同居人と意見が違います。この用紙に、二人の話を分けて書いてもよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市アンケートに異なる二人の意見をどう書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My housemate and I have different opinions. I would like to know whether we can write our views separately on this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to record two people's differing views in the city questionnaire. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのアンケートか、表紙を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the cover so I can see which questionnaire it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: これです。一人が代表して書く物なのか、それぞれ回答する物なのか、説明を読み切れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用紙を示し回答単位の説明を未読と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This one. I have not finished reading the explanation of whether one person fills it in on behalf of everyone or each person answers individually.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the form and say that you have not read all the instructions about who should respond. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回答の単位や記入方法を、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check with the responsible department who should respond and how to fill it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私の意見だけを二人分として書かず、同居人にも回答の方法を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分意見を二人分とせず回答方法を同居人へ知らせたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I do not want to write only my opinion as both our answers, and I would like to tell my housemate how to respond too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to inform your housemate of the response method without treating your own views as both people's answers. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同居人の方は、ご自身で回答される予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is your housemate planning to respond personally?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。日本語を読むのを手伝いますが、意見まで同じにするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 日本語読解補助と意見共有を分け本人回答を希望すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will help them read the Japanese, but I do not intend to make our opinions the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish helping with Japanese reading from sharing opinions, and say that you want your housemate to answer personally. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれのご希望と、用紙の案内を分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check each person's wishes separately from the form's instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。回答方法を聞いてから、同居人と別々に内容を考えます。記入済みの欄も必要なら見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単位確認後に各自内容を考え既記入欄も見直すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. After asking how to respond, my housemate and I will each think about our own answers. We will also review the fields already filled in if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after checking who should respond, you will each consider your own answers and review completed fields too. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当に記入方法を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then I will check the completion method with the responsible department. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手元の書類について、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Has something happened with the documents you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の紙をまとめたら、知らない人の名前の封筒が混ざっていました。誰の物か読まずに、ここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分資料に他人名の封筒が混入し内容を読まず届けたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I gathered my papers together, an envelope with a stranger's name was mixed in. I brought it here without reading to find out whose it was.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that an envelope bearing someone else's name was mixed into your documents and that you brought it in without reading its contents. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中は開けていませんか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、封は閉じたままです。外の名前だけ見て、自分の物ではないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封で外名のみから自分物でないと気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it is still sealed. I saw only the name on the outside and realized it was not mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is unopened and you realized it was not yours from only the name outside. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。どこで混ざったか覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check it here. Do you remember where it might have got mixed in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待合の机で自分の紙を置きました。その時かもしれませんが、誰が置いたかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待合机で紙を置いたが混入時と他人行為は未目撃と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put my papers on the table in the waiting area. It may have been then, but I did not see who put it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you placed your papers on a waiting-area table but did not see when it got mixed in or what another person did. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。封筒は受付でお預かりして確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Reception will keep the envelope and check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。名前を大声で呼んで持ち主を探すより、受付へ返した方がよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 大声で氏名呼出せず受付へ返却したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I thought it would be better to return it to reception than to call the name out loudly to find the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to return it to reception without calling out the person's name loudly. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご自身の書類も、必要な物がそろっているか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check that you have all your own necessary documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。この封筒を渡してから、自分の案内紙と控えを見直します。中身を写真に撮ったりもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒返却後に自分資料を点検し撮影も未実施と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After handing over this envelope, I will check my information sheet and copies again. I have not photographed the contents either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after returning the envelope you will check your own documents, and that you have not taken photographs either. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。それでは、こちらで確認します。診察までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. We will check it here. Please wait until your examination. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 道で気になることがありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice something concerning in the street?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 首輪のある犬が、一匹で歩いていました。飼い主は見えず、車の通る道へ出そうだったので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 首輪付きの単独犬が車道へ出そうで相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A dog wearing a collar was walking alone. I could not see its owner, and it looked about to go onto a road with traffic, so I would like to report it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a lone dog with a collar that appears about to enter the road. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこで見ましたか。今も近くにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you see it? Is it still nearby?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店の角です。私は犬から離れて来ました。今どこにいるかまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店角で最後に見たが現在地不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the corner of the shop. I came away from the dog. I do not know where it is now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you last saw it at the shop corner but do not know its current location. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 追いかけたり、触ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you chase or touch it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。茶色の小さな犬で、首輪は青かったと思います。写真は撮れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 接触追跡なしで茶色小型と青首輪らしい特徴を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. It was a small brown dog, and I think the collar was blue. I could not take a photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not touch or chase it and describe it as small and brown with what appeared to be a blue collar. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる特徴と場所を伺います。けがをしている様子はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask about the features and location you could confirm. Did it seem injured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 普通に歩いていましたが、近くで確かめていません。元気だと断定せず、見た様子だけ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩行は見たが健康状態は近くで未確認と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was walking normally, but I did not check it close up. I will tell you only what I saw, without stating that it was healthy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish seeing it walk from not checking its health close up. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所を確認して対応を検討します。ご自身で捕まえようとしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the location and consider a response. Please do not try to catch it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。この地図で店の角を示します。犬の様子を見るために道へ戻らず、ここで必要なことを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 地図で位置を示し自分で捕獲に戻らず説明する旨述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will point out the shop corner on this map. I will explain what you need here rather than going back to the road to check on the dog.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will show the location on the map and explain it without going back to catch the dog yourself. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 知らせていただきありがとうございます。それでは、場所を確認します。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. Then we will check the location. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 送り先が複数あるというご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about having several destinations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。一つの手紙を三人の友達で順番に読みたいです。三つの住所を書けば、順に届けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同一手紙の三人回覧を三住所記入で実行可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want three friends to read the same letter in turn. If I write three addresses, can you deliver it to them in order?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether writing three addresses will allow one letter to circulate among three friends. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらでは、一回の発送でお届けする宛先を確認します。その後の発送は別に準備が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here we check one delivery destination for each mailing. Any subsequent mailing must be prepared separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですか。最初の友達から次の友達へ送ってもらう必要があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人目から次への再発送が必要と理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. So the first friend needs to send it on to the next friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the first person must mail it again to the next person. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 再度送る場合の宛先や費用についても、送り出す方が確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person sending it again should also check the address and cost.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。最初の封筒へ三人分の住所を並べず、まず一人目の宛先を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最初封筒は一人目のみ記入する方針を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will write the first friend's address first, rather than listing all three people's addresses on the first envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will write only the first person's address on the first envelope. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手紙を回す計画は、皆さんにお伝えしていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you told everyone about the plan to circulate the letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 話しています。ただ、次の発送の費用まで私が済ませたと思っているかもしれないので、そこを説明し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 回覧は共有済だが後送費用の誤解を仲間へ訂正すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. But they may think I have already paid for the later mailings too, so I will explain that part again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that everyone knows about circulation but you will correct any misunderstanding about the cost of subsequent mailing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 再発送に使う封筒なども、その都度状態を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the condition of the envelope and other materials used each time you mail it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。読んだ人が次の人へ送る準備をするよう相談します。今日は一人目への発送についてだけ案内をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各自再発送準備を相談し今日一人目発送のみを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will discuss having each reader prepare to send it to the next person. Today, please advise me only about mailing it to the first person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will discuss each person preparing the next mailing, and ask for advice only about mailing to the first person today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、最初のお届け先を確認します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then we will check the first delivery address. Goodbye.
